title: Andy Keep - Writing a Nanopass Compiler
summary: Andy Keep's Clojure/Conj talk on writing a nanopass compiler, built from many single-task passes with formally defined intermediate languages. It covers the framework's origins in a compiler teaching course at Indiana University.
why: Cited alongside compiler-construction resources as the go-to talk on the nanopass approach used in Chez Scheme.

quote.text: Andrew Keep has a great talk on this approach [2].
